# feedMyPixel

> Ben Chidgey — contract full-stack engineer trading as feedMyPixel Ltd. Twenty years building for
> the Guardian, the BBC and UK government. Available worldwide and remote.

## About

Ben Chidgey has worked as a contract engineer since 2010, mostly on public-facing services with a
strong accessibility and progressive-enhancement bias. Recent work is SvelteKit, TypeScript, Node and
AWS. Clients include the Guardian, the BBC, DEFRA, the Ministry of Justice, HMRC, HM Passport Office,
Marks & Spencer, Wayfair, Pret A Manger and Deutsche Telekom.

## Products

- [Pipes](https://github.com/feedmypixel/pipes): CI/CD pipeline monitoring as a browser extension.
  Watches GitHub Actions and GitLab CI/CD, and goes loud the moment a default branch breaks. Fully
  client-side — no server, no tracking. Published on the Chrome Web Store and Firefox Add-ons.
